title: cotoneaster × intermedius
intro: Cotoneaster × intermedius, commonly known as the hybrid cotoneaster, is a cross between Cotoneaster integerrimus and Cotoneaster horizontalis, resulting in a shrub with attractive white flowers and red berries. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, supporting cardiovascular health and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster × intermedius include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and potentially reduce anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant are primarily triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
